trust_detail: Evaluator verified by golden tests and 5-way cross-check. No trusted retrieval score: the current code has not been run on the real dataset under the frozen protocol.

retrieval_config.bm25: rank_bm25 BM25Okapi k1=1.6 b=0.75, positive IDF, camel/snake splitting, English+code stopwords, title field weight 2.0 (title = doc id on Apps)
retrieval_config.dense: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384-d, normalized, dot product, threshold 0.05, max 256 word-pieces
retrieval_config.official_representation: one vector per document (benchmark/run_mteb.py); windows only in the direct adapter via apps_fixed.npy
retrieval_config.hybrid: RRF k=60, lexical_weight=1.0, semantic_weight=1.0, union of both lists
retrieval_config.reranker: NONE — CROSS_ENCODER_AVAILABLE hardcoded False; 'reranked' mode aliases hybrid
retrieval_config.tie_break: ASTFLOW: doc id ascending; MTEB/trec_eval re-sort ties by doc id descending
